title: Artificial intelligence-based detection of small and intermediate-to-large lymphocytes for cytologic diagnosis of canine lymphoma.
summary: YOLOv11 transfer-learned on cytology images detects lymphocyte classes; 34 lymphoma and 11 non-lymphoma aspirates from 44 dogs, 25,761 cells/680 images; aspirate diagnosis inferred from intermediate/large cell proportion. Five-fold plus held-out test and cross-device configurations; test F1 86.02% overall, intermediate/large class precision 90.58%, recall 82.62%. Small retrospective veterinary sample.
ai_technology: YOLOv11, transfer-learned on cytology images, detects canine lymphoma lymphocyte classes; cell proportions support the aspirate-level diagnostic classification.
